prompt: A Chinese baby mermaid lies peacefully on a fishing net by the river. The baby mermaid has a delicate, almost translucent appearance, covered in wet water, smooth, pale skin and a small, round head. Her hair was short and dark, her eyes were closed, and she seemed to be sleeping. Her ears were pointy, pixie, and her tail, fishy in color and orange, became a slender, fin-like structure. The net beneath her was white and coarse, in contrast to her smooth, almost transparent skin. The background is a vague natural environment, perhaps a lake or a river, with green and blue marks indicating water. The net is placed on a flat surface, maybe a rock or a piece of wood, and some dry brown vegetation can be seen in the upper right corner. The overall ambiance of this photo is serene and dreamy, emphasizing the peaceful coexistence of Chinese baby mermaids. --ar 9:16 --style raw --stylize 250 --v 6.1
